title: Madārij Afhām al-Afvāj fī Tafsīr Āyat Samāniyat Azvāj ('On the Levels of Understanding of Various Groups as to the Exegesis of the Verse Eight Couples')

date.basis: MK: 'completed on' this date in Mazandaran; the same as the Majlis 10196 colophon (ff. 352b-59b); the folio lies in the second half, whose dates MK assumes are more likely composition (p.79); not asterisked.

addressee: A local ruler at whose request it was written; 'perhaps Sayyid Murtażā Marʿashī' (MK, n.25)
occasion: Written at a local ruler's request.
manuscript: 4 items listed; earliest dated: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 352b-59b (6 Dhū l-Qaʿda 831/17 Aug 1428); then MS 5423 (842/1439), MS 10004 (903-4/1497-98), MS 3035/18 (1084/1673).
summary: A detailed commentary on the 'eight couples' verse, ascending through seven levels of interpretation from exoteric exegetes to the House of the Prophet.
